SELECT DISTINCT t.treatmentname, COUNT(DISTINCT t.patientunitstayid) as count
FROM treatment t
JOIN patient p ON t.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid
JOIN diagnosis di ON t.patientunitstayid = di.patientunitstayid
WHERE di.diagnosisname LIKE '%discharge planning consult%'
AND di.diagnosetime >= DATE('2024-01-01')
AND di.diagnosetime <= DATE('2024-01-31')
AND di.diagnosetime >= DATE('2024-12-01')
AND di.diagnosetime <= DATE('2024-12-31')
GROUP BY t.treatmentname
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT t.treatmentname, COUNT(DISTINCT t.treatmentid) as count
FROM patient p
JOIN diagnosis d ON p.patientunitstayid = d.patientunitstayid
JOIN treatment t ON p.patientunitstayid = t.patientunitstayid
WHERE p.patienthealthsystemstayid = 2105123456
AND d.diagnosistime >= '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY t.treatmentname
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT treatmentname, COUNT(*) AS num_procedures
FROM treatment
JOIN patient ON treatment.patientunitstayid = patient.patientunitstayid
JOIN diagnosis ON treatment.diagnosisid = diagnosis.diagnosisid
JOIN lab ON treatment.labid = lab.patientunitstayid
JOIN intakeoutput ON treatment.treatmentid = intakeoutput.intakeoutputid
JOIN vitalperiodic ON intakeoutput.cellpath = vitalperiodic.observationtime
WHERE patient.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
AND patient.age BETWEEN 18 AND 65
AND patientethnicity IN ('White', 'Black', 'Hispanic', 'Asian')
AND patienthospitalid IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
AND patientwardid IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
AND patientadmissionheight > 0
AND patientadmissionweight > 0
AND patientdischargeweight > 0
AND patienthospitaladmittime > 0
AND patienthospitaladmitsource = 'Oxygen'
AND patienthospitaladmittime < DATE('2024-01-01')
AND patienthospitaladmittime > DATE('2023-12-31')
GROUP BY treatmentname
HAVING COUNT(*) IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
ORDER BY num_procedures DESC

FROM treatment t
JOIN patient p ON t.patientunitstayid = p.patientunitstayid
